rules.description: A substantive Engineer implementation commit must follow the Architect decision or schema that authorizes its contract.
A substantive Engineer repair must follow a failing Inspector contract or an explicit governed exception.
A Machine record emission must follow the Architect-owned schema and validated verb that govern its shape.

historical_exceptions.reason: Immutable ordering inversions disclosed by DII-113 and BL-106; no history is rewritten and the exception does not apply prospectively.
